cases.case_label: Recurrent Japanese Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4 (c.4052_4053ins328)
cases.disease: Autosomal recessive retinitis pigmentosa and cone/cone-rod dystrophy
cases.mechanism_detail: The known Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4 causes a frameshift (p.Tyr1352AlafsTer9); in this Japanese cohort it was the most frequent pathogenic RP1 allele (16/50 alleles), homozygous in 4 patients (3 families) and compound heterozygous in 8 (8 families) with AR-RP or AR-COD/CORD.
cases.quote: The Alu element insertion was the most frequently observed pathogenic variant (32.0%, 16/50 alleles) in our Japanese patients with RP1-associated retinal dystrophies.
